studies.title: Which of these products would you actually consider buying?

before.summary: Original production order captured before Terac recruitment.

items.name: Laptop Cooling Pad with Fan
items.copy: Slim laptop cooling pad with quiet fan. Fits up to 15.6 inches. USB powered. Adjustable height.

items.name: USB-C Fast Charging Cable 6ft
items.copy: Braided nylon USB-C cable. Fast charging up to 60W. 6-foot length. Durable connectors. Works with Samsung, Pixel, iPad.

items.name: Screen Cleaner Spray Kit
items.copy: Streak-free screen cleaner for phones, laptops, tablets. Includes microfiber cloth. Travel-sized.

items.name: Foldable Phone Stand Adjustable
items.copy: Aluminum alloy foldable phone and tablet stand. Adjustable angle. Anti-slip pads. Folds flat for travel.

items.name: Cable Organizer Clips 10-Pack
items.copy: Keep your desk clean. Self-adhesive cable management clips. Pack of 10. Works on wood, glass, and plastic.

items.name: Phone Ring Light for Selfies
items.copy: Clip-on ring light for your phone. 3 brightness levels. Rechargeable. Perfect for selfies, video calls, and TikTok.

items.name: Wireless Earbuds with Charging Case
items.copy: True wireless Bluetooth earbuds with noise isolation. 20-hour battery with charging case. Touch controls. Compatible with iPhone and Android.

items.name: Portable Mini Fan USB
items.copy: Compact USB desk fan with 3 speeds. Whisper quiet. Perfect for office, dorm, or travel. USB-C powered.

items.name: Magnetic Phone Mount for Car
items.copy: Ultra-strong magnetic car phone holder. Sticks to any dashboard or vent. Works with all phones. 360-degree rotation.

items.name: LED Strip Lights RGB 16 Colors
items.copy: Color-changing LED strip lights with remote control. 16 colors, multiple modes. Perfect for bedroom, gaming setup, or dorm room. USB powered.

feedback.result: Across 100 real purchase-likelihood ratings, the overall mean was 3.13/5. USB-C Cable ranked first at 3.9/5; Laptop Cooling Pad ranked second at 3.8/5 and received the most most-likely selections (3). Usefulness was selected by 9 respondents and attractive price by 7. This small panel is directional, not statistically significant.

changes.description: Applied the approved-response ranking to all 10 products; USB-C Cable moved from position 2 to 1 and Magnetic Phone Mount moved from position 9 to 3.

after.summary: Production catalog reordered from approved Terac evidence; products, prices, copy, availability, and checkout links are unchanged.
